h1: Custom Drinkware Ordering, Artwork and Payment FAQ
lead: Find direct answers about product selection, logo printing, free design, quantities and payment. Product specifications remain model-specific; the commercial rules below apply in their stated scope.
html:
Product quantity and logo color quantity

Most products start at 500 pieces and selected products start at 10. Printed logos have minimums of 250 for one color, 1,000 for two and 2,000 for three; the chosen product quantity also applies.

Payment and contact

We accept T/T, Western Union and Alipay, with USD, CNY, EUR, GBP and other currencies by agreement. Pay 30% deposit and the balance before shipment. Contact niles@boomdrinkware.com.
